vllm_docker_command:
docker run --gpus all \
  --privileged --ipc=host -p 8000:8000 \
  -v ~/.cache/huggingface:/root/.cache/huggingface \
  -v $MOONCAKE_CONFIG_PATH:$MOONCAKE_CONFIG_PATH:ro \
  -e MOONCAKE_CONFIG_PATH=$MOONCAKE_CONFIG_PATH \
  -e PYTHONHASHSEED=0 \
  vllm/vllm-openai:latest Qwen/Qwen3-30B-A3B \
  --trust-remote-code \
  --enable-expert-parallel \
  --distributed_executor_backend mp \
  --async-scheduling \
  --no-enable-prefix-caching \
  --tensor-parallel-size 1 \
  --quantization ascend \
  --kv-transfer-config '{"kv_connector":"MooncakeStoreConnector","kv_role":"kv_both"}'

master.command:
# Reachable by every instance as $MOONCAKE_MASTER_IP:50051.
# 30s KV lease; eviction starts at 95% pool usage and frees 10% per pass.
mooncake_master \
  -rpc_port=50051 \
  -rpc_thread_num=4 \
  -default_kv_lease_ttl=30000 \
  -eviction_high_watermark_ratio=0.95 \
  -eviction_ratio=0.1 \
  -logtostderr
master.description: Lightweight metadata coordinator. One instance per cluster.

mooncake_config_note:
Same file on every instance node. global_segment_size is per GPU (not per
node) — size it so the total across all GPUs fits in the host RAM you can pin.
device_name "" auto-selects RDMA NICs by GPU-NIC PCIe/NUMA affinity.
